description: Decompose the seed hypothesis into 7 testable claims, score each against the computed evidence, and assemble the summary figure from the measured distances, retention scorecard and clade panel
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

ast  = pd.read_csv("final_active_site_scorecard.csv")
dist = pd.read_csv("gpm3_activesite_distances.csv")
cons = pd.read_csv("active_site_conservation.csv")

# ================= claim-by-claim decomposition of the seed hypothesis =================
claims = [
 dict(claim_id="C1",
      claim="Gpm3 keeps the two catalytic histidines of the dPGM active site",
      verdict="SUPPORTED",
      computed_evidence="His8->His14 and His181->His235 both retained; NE2-ND1 pair separation 3.15 A in the AlphaFold model vs 2.79 A in the 1QHF crystal"),
 dict(claim_id="C2",
      claim="Gpm3 has lost residues essential for 3-phosphoglycerate substrate binding",
      verdict="REFUTED",
      computed_evidence="5/8 structurally defined substrate-contact positions retained; all three arginines with published substrate-binding mutagenesis evidence retained (Arg121, Arg147, Arg148); substituted positions are Leu18->Ile, Thr20->Cys, Thr207->Asn, none an arginine"),
 dict(claim_id="C3",
      claim="Gpm3 has lost residues essential for 2,3-BPG cofactor binding",
      verdict="REFUTED",
      computed_evidence="5/7 cofactor-pocket positions retained including Arg7, Arg59, Arg113, Arg114 and Lys97; substitutions are Trp13->Leu and Asn204->Asp"),
 dict(claim_id="C4",
      claim="The Glu general acid is lost",
      verdict="REFUTED",
      computed_evidence="Glu86 (UniProt Glu87) retained as Glu120; side chain sits 3.23 A from crystallographic 3-PGA after superposition vs 4.25 A in Gpm1"),
 dict(claim_id="C5",
      claim="The C-terminal tail residues are substituted",
      verdict="SUPPORTED",
      computed_evidence="Gpm1 VANQGKK, GpmA AAVANQGKAK, PGAM1 VAAQGKAKK, BPGM VEDQGKVKQAKK all share Q-G-K; Gpm3 VRDEGFEKNP and Gpm2 VRNEGFIKNP carry E-G-F. Tail is present at full length, only its sequence differs"),
 dict(claim_id="C6",
      claim="Loss of binding residues is the REASON Gpm3 lacks mutase activity",
      verdict="REFUTED",
      computed_evidence="The binding residues are not lost. 1.038 A backbone RMSD to Gpm1 over 199 atoms; median |delta| side-chain distance to bound 3-PGA 0.83 A, max 2.02 A. The pocket is geometrically intact in the model"),
 dict(claim_id="C7",
      claim="Gpm3 lacks phosphoglycerate mutase activity",
      verdict="SUPPORTED (independently, by direct assay)",
      computed_evidence="Not a computational result. Direct enzyme assay under forced overexpression, PMID 9544241. Unaffected by the refutation of C2-C4 and C6"),
]
claims_df = pd.DataFrame(claims)
claims_df.to_csv("hypothesis_claim_scorecard.csv", index=False)
print("=== CLAIM-BY-CLAIM SCORECARD ===")
for _, r in claims_df.iterrows():
    print(f"{r.claim_id}  {r.verdict:<34} {r.claim}")
print()
vc = claims_df.verdict.str.split().str[0].value_counts()
print(vc.to_string())

# ================= figure =================
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15, 9))
gs  = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1.15, 1], width_ratios=[1.35, 1], hspace=0.42, wspace=0.26)

# --- panel A: retention by functional class ---
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
order = ["catalytic", "cofactor", "substrate"]
labels = {"catalytic":"catalytic\nmachinery", "cofactor":"2,3-BPG\ncofactor pocket", "substrate":"3-PGA\nsubstrate pocket"}
ret = [ast[ast["class"]==c].retained_Gpm3.sum() for c in order]
tot = [(ast["class"]==c).sum() for c in order]
inf = [((ast["class"]==c) & (~ast.retained_Gpm3) & (ast.invariant_in_active_dPGMs)).sum() for c in order]
nin = [t-r-i for t,r,i in zip(tot,ret,inf)]
y = np.arange(3)
axA.barh(y, ret, color="#2e7d32", label="retained")
axA.barh(y, inf, left=ret, color="#c62828", label="substituted, position invariant in active dPGMs")
axA.barh(y, nin, left=np.array(ret)+np.array(inf), color="#f9a825",
         label="substituted, position already varies among active dPGMs")
for i,(r,t) in enumerate(zip(ret,tot)):
    axA.text(t+0.12, i, f"{r}/{t}", va="center", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
axA.set_yticks(y); axA.set_yticklabels([labels[c] for c in order], fontsize=10)
axA.set_xlabel("Gpm1 active-site positions (4.5 A ligand contact)")
axA.set_xlim(0, 9.6); axA.invert_yaxis()
axA.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right", framealpha=0.95)
axA.set_title("A  Gpm3 retains 14/20 Gpm1 active-site positions,\nincluding the pockets the hypothesis says were lost",
              fontsize=11, loc="left", fontweight="bold")

# --- panel B: the 6 substitutions, clade pattern ---
axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
subpos = ["Trp13","Leu18","Thr20","Asn183","Asn204","Thr207"]
panel_cols = ["Gpm1","GpmA_Ecoli","PGAM1_human","BPGM_human","Gpm2_Scer","Gpm3_Scer",
              "Gpm3_Kmarxianus","Gpm3_Zmellis","Gpm3_Kexigua","Gpm3_Munispora","Gpm3_Mservazzii"]
cs = cons.set_index("Gpm1_site").loc[subpos, panel_cols]
M = (cs.values != cs[["Gpm1"]].values).astype(float)
axB.imshow(M, cmap="RdYlGn_r", vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect="auto")
for i in range(M.shape[0]):
    for j in range(M.shape[1]):
        axB.text(j, i, cs.values[i,j], ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9,
                 fontweight="bold" if M[i,j] else "normal")
axB.set_xticks(range(len(panel_cols)))
axB.set_xticklabels([c.replace("_"," ") for c in panel_cols], rotation=55, ha="right", fontsize=8)
axB.set_yticks(range(len(subpos))); axB.set_yticklabels(subpos, fontsize=9)
axB.axvline(3.5, color="black", lw=2)
axB.set_title("B  All 6 substitutions are shared with Gpm2 and fixed\nacross the Gpm3 clade (green = matches Gpm1)",
              fontsize=11, loc="left", fontweight="bold")

# --- panel C: measured distances to crystallographic 3-PGA ---
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
d = dist.sort_values("Gpm1_d_3PG").reset_index(drop=True)
x = np.arange(len(d))
axC.plot(x, d.Gpm1_d_3PG, "o-", color="#1565c0", label="Gpm1 (1QHF crystal)", ms=6)
axC.plot(x, d.Gpm3_d_3PG, "s--", color="#c62828", label="Gpm3 (AlphaFold, superposed)", ms=6)
axC.set_xticks(x); axC.set_xticklabels(d.position, rotation=68, ha="right", fontsize=7)
axC.set_ylabel("min. side-chain distance to 3-PGA (A)")
axC.legend(fontsize=9)
axC.set_title(f"C  Measured, not asserted: median |difference| {d.delta.abs().median():.2f} A, max {d.delta.abs().max():.2f} A",
              fontsize=11, loc="left", fontweight="bold")
axC.grid(alpha=0.3)

# --- panel D: claim verdicts ---
axD = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1]); axD.axis("off")
cmap = {"SUPPORTED":"#2e7d32", "REFUTED":"#c62828"}
axD.text(0.0, 1.02, "D  Seed hypothesis decomposed into 7 claims", fontsize=11,
         fontweight="bold", transform=axD.transAxes)
for i, r in claims_df.iterrows():
    v = r.verdict.split()[0]
    yy = 0.90 - i*0.133
    axD.text(0.0, yy, r.claim_id, fontsize=9.5, fontweight="bold", transform=axD.transAxes)
    axD.text(0.075, yy, v, fontsize=9.5, fontweight="bold", color=cmap[v], transform=axD.transAxes)
    txt = r.claim if len(r.claim) < 62 else r.claim[:59]+"..."
    axD.text(0.30, yy, txt, fontsize=8.2, transform=axD.transAxes, va="baseline")
axD.text(0.0, -0.04,
         "The conclusion (no mutase activity) holds on direct assay.\nThe stated structural reason does not.",
         fontsize=9.5, style="italic", transform=axD.transAxes)

fig.suptitle("GPM3 (Q12326): the active site is intact, so loss of cofactor/substrate binding residues\ncannot be the reason for the absent mutase activity",
             fontsize=13.5, fontweight="bold", y=0.995)
plt.show()
